subject.title: feat: advertise realtime voice provider voices in talk.catalog

question: Should the public realtime-provider SDK freeze a flat provider-wide `voices` list now, or require model-scoped/dynamic voice metadata before exposing this contract?
rationale: Both shapes are plausible, but merging the optional field establishes an external plugin API whose semantics must remain compatible as providers add model-specific voice support.

options.title: Approve flat safe-set metadata
options.body: Define `voices` as the provider-wide safe intersection, correct Google’s metadata, and leave model-specific expansion as an additive future capability.

options.title: Require model-scoped metadata
options.body: Pause the public field and design catalog metadata that maps models to valid voice sets before merging the SDK change.

options.title: Land models projection only
options.body: Keep the shared model and alias projection but defer realtime voice metadata until client and provider semantics are settled.

recommendation.title: Approve flat safe-set metadata
recommendation.body: Define `voices` as the provider-wide safe intersection, correct Google’s metadata, and leave model-specific expansion as an additive future capability.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available history signal is recent work on the shared plugin API and runtime metadata surface where this contract would live.
